name: Adelaide Zoo

practical_fixes.suggested: City zoo; giant panda talks ~1:15pm — confirm adelaidezoo.com.au. Large African species mostly at Monarto Safari Park (separate ticket/site).
practical_fixes.reason: Avoid implying Monarto megafauna are on-site.

do_not_list.name: African lion
do_not_list.reason: Not on Adelaide Zoo animals list; African lions listed at sister Monarto Safari Park.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Not at Adelaide Zoo; Asian elephants at Monarto Safari Park.

do_not_list.name: Western lowland gorilla
do_not_list.reason: Not on official Adelaide Zoo animals list.

do_not_list.name: Chimpanzee
do_not_list.reason: Chimpanzees listed at Monarto, not Adelaide city zoo animals page.

do_not_list.name: Zebra
do_not_list.reason: Plains zebra at Monarto; not on Adelaide animals list.

do_not_list.name: African penguin
do_not_list.reason: Has Little (fairy) penguin, not African penguin. Soft-label to Little penguin if keeping a penguin stop.

do_not_list.name: Galápagos tortoise
do_not_list.reason: Official list has Aldabra tortoise, not Galápagos.

summary: Official Adelaide Zoo list verifies pandas, tiger, giraffe, orangutan, otter; template African megafauna (lion, elephant, gorilla, chimp, zebra) and wrong penguin/tortoise taxa are absent on-site (many live at Monarto). Print list needs hard cut.
